pr.title: feat: skip Copilot review request when existing review is newer than last commit

report.summary: This PR adds `Client.IsCopilotReviewFresh()` to internal/github/github.go and wires it into cmd/root.go so the tool exits early with "already up to date" instead of requesting a Copilot review when Copilot's latest review looks newer than the PR's last commit. The freshness check is implemented by fetching the PR commit list and review list and comparing `submitted_at` with the last commit's `committer.date`, which is a different mechanism than the head-SHA / `commit_id` comparison described in the PR description. Reviewers should focus on whether the commit/review data used is complete and whether timestamp comparison can misclassify a stale review as fresh, since a false "fresh" silently suppresses the review request the tool exists to send.

suggestions.title: Freshness is decided by review timestamp vs. commit timestamp instead of the reviewed commit SHA
suggestions.reason: `return latestCopilotReview.After(lastCommitDate), nil` treats a review as fresh whenever its `submitted_at` is later than the head commit's `committer.date`, without checking which commit the review actually covers. The PR description states the check should compare each Copilot review's `commit_id` against the current PR head SHA, which this implementation does not do. Commit timestamps are also not reliable ordering evidence: `git rebase --committer-date-is-author-date`, `GIT_COMMITTER_DATE`, or imported/cherry-picked patches can give the current head commit a `committer.date` older than a review that was submitted for a previous commit.
suggestions.recommendation: Read the PR head SHA (`GET repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}` -> `head.sha`) and compare it to the `commit_id` field of the Copilot reviews, e.g. return fresh only when some Copilot review has `commit_id == headSHA`; keep the timestamp only as a fallback when `commit_id` is empty.
suggestions.failure_scenario: Copilot starts reviewing commit A; while it is running, the developer pushes commit B (committer date 10:00); Copilot then submits its review of commit A at 10:05. `latestCopilotReview` (10:05) is after `lastCommitDate` (10:00), so the function reports fresh and cmd/root.go exits early: commit B is never reviewed even though Copilot's review only covered A.
